1. VERY BAD SIGN UP PROSESS FOR VRCHAT+ 

2. More information needs to be provided especially around disclosing HOW YOU AGE VERIFY !

3. I think you need to rethink a few things , for me im canceling my support !

Says sign up to VRC+ be age verified does not say anything about using a 3rd party platform "persona" I do not consent to that rubbish, putting my data on these sites, for god sakes are not people aware of all the data breaches, I am not storing my biometric data, you people are insane ! firstly its a nightmare trying to actually subscribe, could not be done as suggested via VR at ALL !! , how about a simple process on your website surely you want subscribers .. this is such a stupid business model when the act of actually subscribing to supporting the program is more difficult then using it !

I have 30+ years in the IT industry and ive seen a lot of the internet develop as I was involved in it , from the late 80's before HTML and webpages , so i hope you take my advice seriously , rethink your approach !
title: Your system is nothing short of ridiculous  !
